passages.text: Our school club has less than an hour to prepare a story corner before the visitors arrive. Mia asks whether we should spend most of it making a large new sign. “Of course not,” Ben replies, because the chairs and books are not ready yet. They agree to reuse last month's sign and give each helper one clear job. Ten minutes before opening, everyone checks that the walkway between the chairs stays wide enough. The corner opens calmly because the group chooses necessary work before adding optional decoration.

parallelText.en: Our school club has less than an hour to prepare a story corner before the visitors arrive.
parallelText.zh: 来访者到来前，学校社团只有不到一小时准备故事角。

parallelText.en: Mia asks whether we should spend most of it making a large new sign.
parallelText.zh: 米娅问是否要把大部分时间用来制作一块大新招牌。

parallelText.en: “Of course not,” Ben replies, because the chairs and books are not ready yet.
parallelText.zh: “当然不，”本回答，因为椅子和书还没准备好。

parallelText.en: They agree to reuse last month's sign and give each helper one clear job.
parallelText.zh: 他们同意重用上个月的招牌，给每位助手分派明确任务。

parallelText.en: Ten minutes before opening, everyone checks that the walkway between the chairs stays wide enough.
parallelText.zh: 开放前十分钟，大家检查椅子间通道是否保持足够宽。

parallelText.en: The corner opens calmly because the group chooses necessary work before adding optional decoration.
parallelText.zh: 故事角顺利开放，因为小组先做必要工作，再考虑额外装饰。

passages.text: More and more families are using our school's weekend swap shelf for items they no longer need. Each item needs a short note so that another family knows its condition. For example, a puzzle note can say that all its pieces are present but the box is worn. Mia and Ben compare two notes and notice that clear details are more useful than saying “nice”. They make a small question card asking about missing parts, damage and safe use. The shelf becomes easier to use as families share honest information instead of relying on appearances alone.

parallelText.en: More and more families are using our school's weekend swap shelf for items they no longer need.
parallelText.zh: 越来越多家庭使用学校周末交换架，交换不再需要的物品。

parallelText.en: Each item needs a short note so that another family knows its condition.
parallelText.zh: 每件物品需要简短说明，让别的家庭知道它的状况。

parallelText.en: For example, a puzzle note can say that all its pieces are present but the box is worn.
parallelText.zh: 例如，拼图说明可以写所有拼片齐全，但盒子有磨损。

parallelText.en: Mia and Ben compare two notes and notice that clear details are more useful than saying “nice”.
parallelText.zh: 米娅和本比较两份说明，发现明确细节比只说“很好”更有用。

parallelText.en: They make a small question card asking about missing parts, damage and safe use.
parallelText.zh: 他们制作小问题卡，询问缺件、损坏和安全使用情况。

parallelText.en: The shelf becomes easier to use as families share honest information instead of relying on appearances alone.
parallelText.zh: 家庭分享真实信息，而不只看外表，使交换架更容易使用。
